title: haworthia transiens

Haworthia transiens has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, where it is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Haworthia transiens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
